design.common_driver_case: Binary Markov environment E; X and Y are independently noisy observations of E. Estimate TE proxy I(X[t-1];Y[t]|Y[t-1]) and condition additionally on E[t-1].
design.synergy_case: Independent binary X and E; Y[t]=X[t-1] XOR E[t-1] XOR Bernoulli(0.05). Compare pairwise and conditioned directed information, joint synergy proxy, factorial lesion interaction, lesion/rescue and shuffled co-source control.

interpretation: Unconditioned directed-information proxies can look nonzero under a common temporal driver; conditioning on the measured driver collapses the signal by roughly three orders of magnitude.
Pairwise directed information can miss XOR-like higher-order causal structure; conditioning on the co-source reveals roughly 0.714 bits of directed predictive information.
Higher-order joint information plus a nonzero factorial interaction is still not sufficient alone; matched lesion, rescue and shuffled-source controls provide the causal specificity.
These results support a measurement bundle rather than any single emergence scalar.
limitations: The simple synergy proxy is not a formal PID/PEID estimator.
No claim about phenomenal consciousness is supported.
next_target_test: Implement the same four-way control bundle on frozen H1 WorkspaceEpisodes: baseline, mechanism lesion, truthful rescue, shuffled/provenance-broken rescue; report conditioned directed flow and higher-order decomposition with estimator/version/sample/provenance receipts.
